scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build -w @byfungsi/lipat && npm run build -w @lipat/demo
scripts.verify: npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test && cargo test --workspace && npm run build && node scripts/check-package.mjs && npm run verify:workerd && npm run verify:native && npm run docs:compile
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run build -w @byfungsi/lipat && npm run templates:build && npm run dev -w @lipat/demo
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs && vitepress docs --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && npm run docs:compile
scripts.format: prettier --write packages examples scripts tests docs *.json *.ts *.md
scripts.verify:browser: node scripts/verify-browser.mjs && node scripts/verify-scene-browser.mjs && node scripts/verify-editor-browser.mjs && node scripts/verify-templates-browser.mjs
